title: drivers: Wire create_body_tracker for SteamVR and Remote
message:
drivers: Wire create_body_tracker for SteamVR and Remote

These drivers already override create_hand_tracker with the base
implementation after u_system_devices_populate_function_pointers, but
left create_body_tracker on the NI stub so body tracker creation always
failed even when a body-role device was present.
